profile.headline: Software Engineer | React & Flask Developer | Focused on Frontend Design and Enhanced User Experiences
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in frontend development with hands-on experience delivering scalable, responsive web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks, REST APIs, and full-stack architectures. Passionate about building clean, maintainable code and translating complex business needs into intuitive user experiences. Proficient in ReactJS, Context API, React Router, Redux, and RESTful API integrations, with additional experience in TypeScript, Python (Flask), and MySQL.

Comfortable working across both frontend and backend layers, I’ve built full-stack applications incorporating dynamic state management, secure authentication flows, and RESTful API design using Python (Flask), MySQL, and SQLAlchemy. Skilled at integrating third-party APIs, handling data synchronization, and optimizing backend performance.

Experienced collaborating within Agile cross-functional teams, partnering with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, and Backend Developers to deliver functional, user-centered solutions. Active contributor to sprint planning, daily standups, code reviews, and technical documentation.

Technical Proficiencies:

Programming Languages: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Python, HTML5, CSS3, SQL

Frontend Technologies: ReactJS, React Router, Context API, Styled Components, Bootstrap, Responsive UI Design, REST API Integration

Backend Technologies: Flask, MySQL, CRUD Operations, SQLAlchemy, Marshmallow

API & Data Integration: Axios, Fetch, Postman

Version Control & Collaboration: Git, GitHub, Agile Methodologies

Testing & Tools: Jest, VS Code, npm, Vite

Projects:

MedPlus (Frontend Developer): Delivered a medication management MVP featuring multi-step onboarding, profile creation, prescription uploads, reminders, and fully responsive React architecture. Designed frontend architecture using state synchronization, routing, and Context API to simulate full-stack behavior. Partnered with UX/UI Designer to convert Figma wireframes into scalable, reusable components aligned with modern UI/UX standards.

I’m excited to bring my technical skills, problem-solving mindset, and collaborative approach to a team where I can continue growing and contribute to meaningful projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer Trainee, I honed my skills in full-stack development by working on diverse projects that combined modern frontend, backend, and database technologies. The role emphasized hands-on learning, enabling me to build scalable, maintainable, and user-focused applications.

- Developed full-stack applications using React for creating responsive and dynamic user interfaces, Flask for robust and secure backend APIs, and MySQL for reliable and efficient database management. These applications demonstrated best practices in modular development and scalability.

- Implemented secure authentication using JWT (JSON Web Tokens) to safeguard sensitive user data and ensure secure communication between clients and servers. This practice upheld industry standards for data security and privacy.

- Refined expertise in optimizing database queries to improve data retrieval times and overall application efficiency. Leveraged GraphQL to streamline data requests and enhance both scalability and performance for dynamic applications.

- Leveraged TypeScript, Redux, and Context API to improve state management across projects, ensuring seamless data flow and improving application performance and maintainability.

-Enhanced application functionality and user experience by integrating third-party APIs such as payment gateways and external data services, ensuring reliable and consistent performance across all integrations.

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
As a Pharmacy Technician, I supported healthcare operations by ensuring the accurate preparation and delivery of medications. The role required exceptional attention to detail, adherence to safety protocols, and collaboration with a multidisciplinary healthcare team to improve patient outcomes.

- Filled and delivered over 200 medication orders daily, consistently ensuring accuracy and patient safety. Maintained a high level of attention to detail to prevent errors in a high-stakes environment.

- Identified and reported potentially harmful medication errors to pharmacists, contributing to a culture of patient safety and compliance with hospital, state, and federal regulations. This proactive approach mitigated risks and maintained quality standards.

- Conducted routine inventory checks to remove expired medications, verify narcotic substance counts, and ensure compliance with all regulatory standards. Streamlined inventory processes to support timely restocking and operational efficiency.

- Collaborated with pharmacists and healthcare teams to improve workflows, enhance quality control, and ensure that patients received timely and accurate medication care.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Frontend Developer at Co.Lab, I collaborated in a small, cross-functional team to build a minimum viable product (MVP). This fast-paced project provided an opportunity to transform designs into responsive and functional applications while balancing tight deadlines and team collaboration.

- Collaborated in an Agile, cross-functional team with a designer, product manager, and backend developer to deliver an MVP on a tight deadline. Maintained effective communication to address feedback quickly and align on priorities.

-Transformed Figma designs into a responsive React-based frontend, implementing pixel-perfect UI components optimized for usability on both desktop and mobile devices.

- Drafted a technical one-pager outlining the app’s architecture, tech stack, and key functionalities. This document served as a reference for team members and mentors, streamlining development and ensuring alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

- Utilized time management and problem-solving skills to address unforeseen technical challenges, meeting project milestones while maintaining a high standard of quality.
